formation_structure.artillery: Verified ranges give both Hibiscus and RIGHT-facing Ansel direct coverage of Steward at [5,7]. Ansel also covers Friston and opening Melantha. This replaces the single-medic Steward assignment that failed.
formation_structure.capacity: Ten distinct IDs; the fixed timeline never exceeds eight simultaneously deployed operators, including robots.
formation_structure.central: Lava at [2,3] RIGHT covers Fang and Midnight, avoiding the cluster adjacent to Hibiscus. Melantha supplies lower physical damage from behind Friston. Returning Steward covers both central blocker tiles.
formation_structure.clearance: Keep western restraints until hostile pressure has ended. Redeploy Lava and Melantha to destroy the restraints, then observe both actual protected-target arrivals.
formation_structure.economy: Read-only arithmetic passed with initial 10 DP, natural recovery and Fang's living automatic income. Every deployment remains affordable when all retreat refunds are ignored. Opening balances after Midnight, Melantha, Lancet, Ansel and Steward are approximately 6.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03 and 0.03 DP.
formation_structure.medical_limit: RIGHT-facing Ansel cannot heal Hibiscus or central Melantha at [4,4]. Hibiscus must survive her own artillery exposure using scheduled self-healing. Central Melantha depends on living blockers keeping hostile attacks assigned upstream.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Midnight retain their crossfire into Friston's interception. Lancet's global recovery remains, but ordinary healing now restores Midnight. Friston receives no assumed ordinary Lancet healing; Hibiscus must establish central recovery at frame 1321.

tactical_thesis: Keep the demonstrated opening interceptions, but change Ansel to RIGHT so both medics directly heal eastern Steward. Move Lancet to restore Midnight before eastern shelling, replacing Midnight's former dependence on Ansel's extension. Sustain artillery damage through the eastern flight, establish separate upper arts and lower physical clearance, and preserve both central blockers through the final armor. This is an unexecuted candidate with explicit survival and clearance deadlines.
